title: Classical density functional theory for confined fluids
aliases: 经典密度泛函 连续密度泛函 cDFT classical DFT Vext external potential adsorption pore fluid density profile 吸附 外场 分子密度
claim: Classical cDFT describes an inhomogeneous molecular fluid using a density profile and a free-energy functional under an external potential; it can model adsorption thermodynamics in pores.
scope: Classical fluid adsorption and equilibrium thermodynamics in confined media.
caveat: 这里的 cDFT 是经典流体密度泛函，不是电子结构 DFT；不能仅凭它宣称电子结合能或膜渗透率。
citation: Percus, Model grand potential for a nonuniform classical fluid, J. Chem. Phys. 75, 1316 (1981), doi:10.1063/1.442136.

title: Adsorption metrics are distinct from membrane transport metrics
aliases: GCMC uptake adsorption selectivity membrane permeance permeability diffusion diffusivity solubility 吸附量 吸附选择性 膜 渗透率 渗透性 扩散
claim: Equilibrium uptake and adsorption selectivity characterize sorption. A membrane separation claim additionally requires transport evidence, such as diffusivity or measured/simulated permeation under a defined operating condition.
scope: Gas separation screening of MOF adsorbents and membranes.
caveat: Adsorption selectivity alone does not establish membrane permeance or permeation selectivity; diffusion and membrane conditions matter.
citation: High-Throughput Screening of MOF Adsorbents and Membranes for H2 Purification and CO2 Capture, ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces (2018), doi:10.1021/acsami.8b12746.

title: Solution-diffusion membrane model
aliases: solution diffusion model polymer membrane permeability permeance thickness selectivity solubility diffusivity P equals S D 聚合物膜 溶解扩散 渗透率 厚度
claim: For dense polymer membranes under the solution-diffusion model, permeability is the product of solubility and diffusivity, and permeance also depends on membrane thickness.
scope: Dense polymer membrane gas transport; do not assume the same constitutive model for every porous membrane.
caveat: The solution-diffusion relation has a model scope; adsorption uptake alone does not determine diffusion or a membrane flux.
citation: Lively and Sholl, Maximizing the right stuff: The trade-off between membrane permeability and selectivity, Science (2016), doi:10.1126/science.aab0530.

title: Uni-MOF predicts gas adsorption targets
aliases: Uni-MOF UniMol Uni-Mol MOF 3D encoder gas pressure temperature adsorption capacity representation learning 吸附 模型 三维结构
claim: Uni-MOF uses three-dimensional framework representations together with gas and operating-condition information for gas adsorption prediction.
scope: Adsorption prediction for structures and conditions represented in its training and evaluation regime.
caveat: A predicted adsorption capacity is a model estimate, not an independent physical calculation or a validated membrane permeance result.
citation: Wang et al., A comprehensive transformer-based approach for high-accuracy gas adsorption predictions in metal-organic frameworks, Nat. Commun. 15, 1904 (2024), doi:10.1038/s41467-024-46276-x.

title: Active learning acquires labels after selecting unlabeled candidates
aliases: active learning acquisition unlabeled pool oracle reveal labels iterative training exploration exploitation 主动学习 未标注 采集 真实标签 计算验证
claim: An active-learning round fits on labeled training data, scores an unlabeled candidate pool, obtains selected labels from a real experiment or calculation, and only then updates the training set.
scope: Iterative materials discovery and model improvement.
caveat: Do not use unrevealed candidate labels to choose acquisitions, or describe heuristic committee disagreement as calibrated uncertainty without validation.
citation: Small data machine learning in materials science, npj Comput. Mater. (2023), doi:10.1038/s41524-023-01000-z.

title: Hold out independent test data during model selection
aliases: data leakage train validation test split held out model selection hyperparameters active learning cross validation 数据泄漏 测试集 验证集 归一化
claim: Model-selection and preprocessing decisions must avoid test-set information; evaluation splits should reflect the intended transfer task and dependencies among materials.
scope: Materials machine learning evaluation and active-learning benchmarks.
caveat: Using test labels or test-derived normalization during acquisition or tuning contaminates the final estimate of generalization.
citation: MatFold: systematic insights into materials discovery models' performance through standardized cross-validation protocols, Digital Discovery (2024), doi:10.1039/d4dd00250d.

title: Scientific results require traceable provenance
aliases: FAIR provenance reproducibility workflow inputs outputs units source run id validation evidence report 数据来源 计算记录 单位 结果验收 可复现
claim: Reusable scientific results should retain detailed provenance, including the source data and the workflow or algorithms that produced them.
scope: Evidence-backed scientific workflow outputs and reports.
caveat: A retrieved paper supports a general method claim; it does not prove that a particular calculation or job succeeded.
citation: Wilkinson et al., The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship, Sci. Data 3, 160018 (2016), doi:10.1038/sdata.2016.18.
